question: Create a YAML ConfigMap that stores database host and port configuration

ground_truth.answer:
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: db-config
data:
  DB_HOST: "localhost"
  DB_PORT: "5432"
context: io.k8s.api.core.v1.ConfigMap: holds configuration data as key-value pairs; data field maps string keys to string values; binaryData field maps string keys to base64-encoded byte sequences
